disposition_reason: Tables 2a-2c print mean, minimum and maximum Pb, Cd, total As, inorganic As, Cu, Cr and Sn (mg/kg fresh mass) for 81 foods in 12 groups from the Valencia total diet study, plus total Hg and methylmercury for 12 fish and seafood foods.

study.design: total diet study; 81 foods x 100 samples (8100), pooled into 810 composites of 10 samples; foods analysed as purchased (edible parts), not cooked
study.market: 3 food chains and local markets in 11 cities of the Region of Valencia, Spain
study.method: lyophilisation, microwave HNO3 digestion, ICP-MS (Pb, Cd, tAs, Cu, Cr, Sn); FI-HG-AAS after solvent extraction (iAs); CV-AFS (tHg); HPLC-thermooxidation-CV-AFS (MeHg)
study.lod_text: LOQs in online supplementary Tables S.I.1-S.I.3 (not available); discussion cites tAs LOQ 0.0004-0.010 mg/kg and iAs LOQ 0.0001-0.0049 mg/kg
study.qa: ISO/IEC 17025 accredited labs; reagent blanks, duplicates, fortified samples; CRMs BCR 150, BCR 191, BCR 185R, IRMM 804, DORM-2/3, TORT-2, LGC7162, NIST SRM 1568a (recoveries in supplement, not available)

regulatory_or_exposure.what: EU Regulation 1881/2006 maximum levels cited for comparison; swordfish MeHg/tHg values exceeded the 1 mg/kg limit in some composites
Dietary exposure for this TDS reported in Marin et al. 2016 (Food Addit Contam Part A 34:228-240), ref [18]

unresolved: LOQ values per analyte and matrix are in online supplementary tables that were not with the PDF; non-detects carry lod_ugkg null.
Basis: table headers say mg/kg fresh mass, but Section 2.3.1 says residual moisture was determined 'to correct the final results expressed in dry mass'. Table basis (fresh) was used.

The same Valencia TDS 2010-2011 data were used for a dietary exposure paper (Marin et al. 2016, ref [18], not in corpus); this paper states it gives more complete per-food reporting, so all per-food values here were extracted.
Text errors: Section 4.3 calls the fish tAs mean (2.1669 mg/kg) an iAs level; Section 3.7 says beef Cr max 222.70 ug/kg while Table 2a prints 2,2237 mg/kg.
Fish rows Tuna to Smoked fish for iAs min/max, Cu, Cr and Sn were garbled in text extraction and were transcribed from the rendered page 662 image.
Comparison tables 3a-3c quote other studies and were not extracted.
'Sherry and plum' is printed as such (Table 2b); probably cherry and plum, kept as printed.
Mineral water is reported in mg/kg in the same tables (all below LOQ except iAs).
Integrity: Sausages Sn: printed mean (0,0172) exceeds printed max (0,0080) for Sn
Integrity: Cured ham iAs: printed mean (0,0042) exceeds printed max (0,0006) for iAs
Integrity: Cured sausage iAs: printed mean (0,0296) exceeds printed max (0,0045) for iAs
Integrity: Pasta Sn: printed mean (0,0881) exceeds printed max (0,0620) for Sn
Integrity: Peppers iAs: printed min (0,0060) exceeds printed max (0,0037) for iAs
Integrity: Milk tAs: printed mean (0,0048) exceeds printed max (0,0015) for tAs
